instruction: Switch the audio output module in VLC to use ALSA instead of the default

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VLC's audio output module to ALSA. This is similar in complexity to the original task which changes the recordings folder. The evaluator checks the aout setting in vlcrc configuration file.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VLC configuration state - get_vlc_config reads vlcrc file from correct OS-specific location
Metric logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement - check_vlc_aout parses aout setting from config and compares with expected 'alsa'
Complete coverage of instruction - evaluator checks all requirements (switching audio output to ALSA)
Expected value is semantically correct - 'alsa' matches the instruction requirement
Correct parameter handling - metric uses 'rule' parameter and directly accesses 'expected_aout' (correct for type='rule')
Proper edge case handling - handles comments, empty lines, missing settings, file errors
State accessibility verified - vlcrc config file persists and is readable even after VLC closes, no postconfig needed
Data flow is correct - getter extracts config file path, metric reads and parses aout setting, compares with expected value
